name: Element 52, Auberge Collection
insider_take: Where periodic table meets peak luxury in Colorado's most exclusive ski town.
whats_special: This ultra-luxe boutique hotel sits at 8,750 feet elevation in a Victorian mining town turned billionaire's playground. The name "Element 52" references Tellurium - the rare element discovered in the region's historic gold mines. With only 87 suites, it's the most intimate luxury property in Telluride's Mountain Village.
pro_tip: Book the Tellurium Suite for panoramic 13,000-foot peak views and priority reservations at Timbers Club, the town's most exclusive private dining venue.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool overlooking the San Juan Mountains, and the complimentary gondola access to Telluride's historic main street - one of the few free ski town transit systems in America. The hotel's ski concierge offers exclusive backcountry heli-skiing access to untouched powder bowls.
pros: Modern alpine design with premium amenities
cons: Premium pricing for luxury mountain resort
Seasonal operations dependent on ski season
